asset_binding.limits: A0 is the asset-ID candidate; A8 is a checked reference token. Neither has cross-reload or cross-process runtime proof. Asset ID alone does not identify one invocation.

start.limits: Triggered is a request, OnReady is a notification candidate. Neither proves actual playback began. OnTriggered is not the Triggered command's start callback. Table-based Started emission remains unlocated.

completion.limits: A threshold-crossing notification can precede the timeline resource threshold by 0.5 units; duration units need runtime proof. It does not assign state 13 and does not prove door/collision/enemy/task/checkpoint cleanup.

terminal.limits: State 13 has TimedOut command and natural exhaustion paths; cannot classify it as natural end or user skip by itself.
